title: CBDT ने Tax Recovery Rules से Arrest और Detention Provisions हटाए!
content:
# CBDT ने Tax Recovery Rules से Arrest और Detention Provisions हटाए!

Ek important update hai. Government ne tax defaulters ke liye tax recovery rules mein changes announce kiye hain, jismein ab arrest aur detention ke provisions ko hata diya gaya hai.

*   **What's New:** Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne Income-tax Rules, 2026 ke Rule 225 mein amendments kiye hain, jiske तहत tax recovery proceedings mein defaulters ko arrest ya detain karne ki power ko delete kar diya gaya hai.
*   **Why this change:** This move aims to make tax recovery procedures more taxpayer-friendly aur less coercive, aligning with modern principles of tax administration. Ab tax recovery primarily attachment and sale of assets jaise property-based mechanisms ke through hogi.
*   **Official Update:** Yeh changes Income-tax (Fourth Amendment) Rules, 2026 ke through notified kiye gaye hain.
*   **Notification Details:** Notification No. 120/2026 (G.S.R. 822(E)) dated September 17, 2026 ko issue hui hai.
*   **Effective Date:** Rules 2 se 4 tak ke amendments (jismein Rule 225 bhi shamil hai) retrospectively April 1, 2026 se effective maane jayenge.
